core_obligations: Uniqueness of adjoints: both Rj^! and j^{-1} are right adjoints to the same functor Rj_! = j_!, so they are equal; the identification of the extension-by-zero functor at the derived level is grounded in lemma-Rf-upper-shriek-for-quasi-finite (tag 0GL8) and lemma-etale-upper-shriek (tag 0F5A) (proof lines 4096-4101).
proof_roadmap: Observe that both Rj^! and j^{-1} are right adjoints to Rj_! = j_! (proof lines 4097-4098).
Conclude equality by uniqueness of adjoints, citing the two named lemmas (proof lines 4098-4100).
